# Season Shelf 1.2.7

- Fixed downloads retrying a disconnected Telegram client. Resumed downloads reconnect using the existing signed-in session and retain their saved progress.
- Fixed the header showing Connected after Telegram disconnects. Connection status now follows Telegram transport updates.
- Concurrent downloads share one reconnect attempt.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned, and the macOS build is not notarized.
